title: Feasibility Analysis of AI-Assisted Structured Documentation of Physician–Patient Interactions in Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery: Evaluation of the Potential, Documentation Quality, and Acceptance of Large Language Models (LLMs) Based on Transcribed Audio Recordings
summary: This study investigates whether artificial intelligence can support physicians in documenting patient consultations. With the patient’s consent, the physician–patient conversation is audio-recorded and transcribed. An AI system then automatically generates a structured medical note from this transcript. This AI-generated documentation is compared with conventional, manually written documentation. The study examines whether this approach improves documentation quality, saves physicians’ time, and how both patients and physicians perceive this type of support. In addition, the study evaluates whether the use of this technology has any impact on the quality of the physician–patient interaction.
conditions: No single specific disease; outpatient initial consultations in oral and maxillofacial surgery involving a variety of conditions.

interventions.name: Intervention group: AI-assisted structured documentation based on transcribed audio recordings of physician–patient interactions
Control group: Conventional documentation of physician–patient interactions without AI support

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
• Outpatient initial consultation in the Department of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery
• Ability to provide informed consent
• Written informed consent to participate in the study and to the audio recording of the physician–patient consultation
• Sufficient command of the German language to participate in the consultation and complete the questionnaires
Exclusion criteria:
• Missing or withdrawn informed consent for study participation or audio recording
• Impaired capacity to provide informed consent
• Acute emergency situations preventing proper study conduct
• Insufficient German language skills to adequately participate in the consultation and questionnaires
